capabilities: Sync Kindle highlights and notes into Obsidian notes
Sync KOReader highlights and merge them with Kindle books
Append only new highlights to existing book files
Render books with custom source templates and highlight colours
Apply Unearthed tags as tag notes or frontmatter properties
extras: The README points to an alternative offline route, Unearthed Local with its Unearthed Mobile companion app, which does not use this plugin; setup requires a browser extension for Kindle and a separate KOReader plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import Kindle or KOReader highlights and keep them updated without duplicates.

relations.evidence: Unearthed is a service that seamlessly syncs your Kindle (& KOReader) highlights and notes to your preferred platforms.
Only the books visible in your Kindle notebook at Amazon Kindle Notebook will be synced.
Highlights and notes made in the KOReader app can now also be sent to Unearthed, and therefore Obsidian.

requires.name: browser extension (Chrome/Firefox) for Kindle sync; KOReader plugin for KOReader sync

summary: Sync client for the Unearthed service that pulls Kindle and KOReader highlights, notes, tags and daily reflections into templated vault notes.
